issues.legal_issue: The applicable reduction in development charges for determining higher compensation was governed by the precedent accepted by the State.
material_facts: The State accepted that the claim was covered by an earlier Supreme Court decision, which reduced the cut in development charges from 40% to 30%.
issues.conclusion: The appeals were disposed of in accordance with the earlier decision, including its reduction of the cut in development charges from 40% to 30%.
issues.legal_principle: The Court applied its earlier decision in Sachin & Ors. v. State of Haryana & Ors., which reduced the cut in development charges from 40% to 30%.

predicates.compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal in which the appellants seek higher compensation.
predicates.state_concedes_claim_covered_by_preceden: The State accepts that the compensation claim is covered by an earlier decision.

issues.definition: When an appeal seeking higher compensation is covered by an earlier decision accepted by the State, the development-charge deduction is applied as required by that decision.

issues.legal_issue: Statutory benefits are unavailable for a period of delay in refiling petitions before the Court.
material_facts: The petitions before the Court had been refiled after a delay.
The appellants sought compensation in appeals before the Court.
issues.conclusion: The appellants were not entitled to statutory benefits for the period of delay in refiling the petitions.
issues.legal_principle: The Court expressly excluded statutory benefits for the period of delay in refiling the petitions; it cited no separate statutory provision or earlier case for this ruling.

predicates.compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal in which the appellants seek compensation.
predicates.petitions_refiled_after_delay: The petitions before the Court were refiled after a delay.

issues.definition: When a compensation appeal involves petitions refiled after a delay, statutory benefits are denied for that delay.
